thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired -> inference-service (eu-west-1): high 5xx rate observed, threshold breached (5m). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-3215555
jamie: acked on PagerDuty, I'm on call. Looking at dashboard now.
alex: thx jamie. can you confirm if it's model infra or gateway?
jamie: quick glance -> surge of 502/504s from gateway-proxy pods, but some downstream gpu nodes showing OOM spikes. digging logs.
priya: tagging runbook: https://wiki/reed/inference/runbooks#gateway-5xx -> start with proxy pod logs + `kubectl describe` + tail proxy logs.
jamie: running `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=gateway-proxy --since=10m | grep -i error` now. seeing `upstream reset` and `context canceled` bursts.
pagerbot: escalation: if no ack within 2m escalate to eng-oncall. jamie acknowledged at 1793215560.
lee: i'm free to help - can take gpu node investigation if you want to split.
jamie: yes please lee, check nodes in eu-west-1-gpu pool for OOM/kubelet restarts (`kubectl get pods -n infra -o wide`)
lee: on it. quick check shows 2 nodes with kernel OOM kills in the last 8m, `kubelet` reported node pressure.
alex: are we seeing traffic spike or a bad model hotload? any recent deploys?
priya: no prod deploys in last 30m (CI shows no release). telemetry shows a traffic spike from a single customer tenant id=acme-inc, rate ~3x baseline.
jamie: set short-term mitigation: enabling additional proxy replicas and routing shift to eu-central fallback pool. applying HPA bump now.
jamie: `kubectl scale deployment gateway-proxy --replicas=8 -n inference` -> done. Monitoring.
lee: cordoned two affected nodes and drained one with OOM history: `kubectl drain node/eu-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets`
priya: customer-impact note: ~2% of requests for the tenant saw 5xx between 12:03-12:09 UTC, some error retries likely surfaced to users. I'll draft PSA.
jamie: after scaling, 5xx rate dropped to baseline in dashboards. tailing logs for 2m to confirm stability.
alex: started fallback routing to eu-central for new sessions to reduce load on eu-west. need to monitor latency impact.
jamie: confirmed stable for 3 consecutive aggregates. Keeping watch. If no regressions in 15m we'll close.
pagerbot: incident escalation cleared -> no further escalation required.
lee: follow-up action: open a post-incident ticket to investigate tenant throttling + node autoscaling thresholds. assigning to platform-sre.
priya: PSA draft: "We observed increased 5xx rates for a short window in eu-west-1 affecting a small subset of traffic; mitigation applied, customers routed to fallback region. Root cause investigation in progress." will post in #customer-impact after review.
jamie: thanks team. I'll handback to normal rotation in 20m if stable. :thumbsup:
